sources.title: Estimated mean annual natural ground-water recharge in the conterminous United States
sources.usage_notes: Recharge values come from the USGS 1-kilometer mean annual natural groundwater recharge raster. The grid reflects broad long-term regional patterns for the conterminous United States, not site-scale conditions.

sources.title: High resolution US water table depth estimates reveal quantity of accessible groundwater
sources.publisher: Nature Communications Earth & Environment / Princeton HydroFrame
sources.dataset_or_report: Modeled mean water-table depth raster (public viewer COG)
sources.usage_notes: Storage values are modeled estimates, not direct USGS aquifer-storage totals. They combine the 2026 Princeton mean water-table depth surface with sampled GLHYMPS porosity values and assume a 392-meter accessible groundwater column for national comparison.

sources.title: GLobal HYdrogeology MaPS 2.0
sources.usage_notes: Porosity values are sampled as a national proxy layer for the modeled storage calculation. This is not a published USGS aquifer-specific storage denominator.
